notes.en: Loads .smf, .sgm and .ssl content, or a .zip game package containing a whole collection.
notes.zh: 支持 .smf、.sgm、.ssl 内容，或包含整套游戏的 .zip 资源包。

hint.en: Optional orientation profile for landscape titles outside the built-in list; place it under coolbaremu/ with this exact name.
hint.zh: 可选的方向配置，用于内置列表之外的横屏游戏；放到 coolbaremu/ 下并保持文件名不变（区分大小写）。

notes.en: Loads .cbe Coolbar applications. Uses a phone keypad: D-pad, Confirm, soft keys and Select for the number layer. Most titles present a 240x400 portrait screen; landscape titles rotate automatically. An optional coolbaremu/coolbaremu_orientation.csv support file covers titles outside the built-in profile.
notes.zh: 加载 .cbe 酷吧应用。操作对应手机键盘：方向键、确认键、左右软键，按住 Select 切换数字层。多数游戏为 240x400 竖屏，横屏游戏会自动旋转。可用可选的 coolbaremu/coolbaremu_orientation.csv 支持文件补充内置列表之外的横屏游戏。

names.zh: 丁果 A320 / 歌美 A330

notes.en: Runs Dingoo A320 .app software and Gemei A330 .cc, .c2s and .c3s software. No BIOS or firmware file is required; battery saves go to the frontend save directory.
notes.zh: 运行丁果 A320 的 .app 程序，以及歌美 A330 的 .cc、.c2s 和 .c3s 程序。无需 BIOS 或固件文件；电池存档写入前端的存档目录。

hint.en: SPG290 internal ROM, exactly 32768 bytes. Keep the name spg290.bin and place it under hyperscanemu/.
hint.zh: SPG290 内部 ROM，大小必须为 32768 字节。文件名保持 spg290.bin，放到 hyperscanemu/ 下。

hint.en: HyperScan BIOS, exactly 1048576 bytes. Keep the name hyperscan.bin and place it under hyperscanemu/.
hint.zh: HyperScan BIOS，大小必须为 1048576 字节。文件名保持 hyperscan.bin，放到 hyperscanemu/ 下。

notes.en: Mattel HyperScan (Sunplus SPG290) with RFID card games. Requires hyperscanemu/spg290.bin and hyperscanemu/hyperscan.bin (case-sensitive); loads .bin, .cue or .zip disc images.
notes.zh: Mattel HyperScan（凌阳 SPG290）主机，支持 RFID 卡牌游戏。需要 hyperscanemu/spg290.bin 与 hyperscanemu/hyperscan.bin（区分大小写）；可加载 .bin、.cue 或 .zip 光盘镜像。

notes.en: Runs LavaX .lav programs with companion files from the same folder, joypad and pointer input, and save states.
notes.zh: 运行 LavaX .lav 程序，支持同目录附属文件、手柄与触摸输入以及即时存档。

notes.en: Loads a .cue with its .bin tracks, a single .iso/.bin/.img image, or a Redump-style .zip containing the CUE/BIN set. No BIOS is required.
notes.zh: 支持 .cue 及其 .bin 轨道、单文件 .iso/.bin/.img，或包含 CUE/BIN 的 Redump 风格 .zip；无需 BIOS。

notes.en: Loads NGame .bin games for Sunplus SPMP8000 handhelds and MP4 players. No firmware or BIOS files are required; the core writes no battery saves.
notes.zh: 加载凌阳 SPMP8000 掌机与 MP4 播放器的 NGame .bin 游戏。无需固件或 BIOS 文件，核心不写入电池存档。

hint.en: NC1020 system ROM (obj_lu.bin, original dump name); needed when the NC1020 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC1020 系统 ROM（obj_lu.bin，保持原始转储名）；选择 NC1020 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC1020 NOR Flash dump; needed when the NC1020 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC1020 NOR Flash 转储；选择 NC1020 机型时需要。

hint.en: PC1000 system ROM dump; needed when the PC1000 model is selected.
hint.zh: PC1000 系统 ROM 转储；选择 PC1000 机型时需要。

hint.en: PC1000 NOR Flash dump; needed when the PC1000 model is selected.
hint.zh: PC1000 NOR Flash 转储；选择 PC1000 机型时需要。

hint.en: CC800 system ROM (obj.bin, original dump name); needed when the CC800 model is selected.
hint.zh: CC800 系统 ROM（obj.bin，保持原始转储名）；选择 CC800 机型时需要。

hint.en: CC800 NOR Flash dump; needed when the CC800 model is selected.
hint.zh: CC800 NOR Flash 转储；选择 CC800 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC2000 NOR Flash dump; needed when the NC2000 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC2000 NOR Flash 转储；选择 NC2000 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC2000 NAND Flash dump; needed when the NC2000 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC2000 NAND Flash 转储；选择 NC2000 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC2000 first NAND plane; needed when the NC2000 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC2000 第一 NAND 平面；选择 NC2000 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC3000 NOR Flash dump; needed when the NC3000 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC3000 NOR Flash 转储；选择 NC3000 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC3000 NAND Flash dump; needed when the NC3000 model is selected.
hint.zh: NC3000 NAND Flash 转储；选择 NC3000 机型时需要。

hint.en: NC3000 first NAND plane; optional, used when the dump provides it.
hint.zh: NC3000 第一 NAND 平面；可选，有对应转储时会使用。

notes.en: Boots the original firmware of Wenquxing NC1020, PC1000, CC800, NC2000 and NC3000 electronic dictionaries. Firmware is user-supplied: put the dumps of the chosen model under the system directory as wqxemu/<model>/ using the exact case-sensitive file names, then pick the model before starting. There is no game content; the core boots from firmware alone. Input uses the libretro keyboard interface, with the directional keys also mapped to the RetroPad.
notes.zh: 运行文曲星 NC1020、PC1000、CC800、NC2000、NC3000 电子词典的原机固件。固件需用户自备：把所选机型的转储按区分大小写的固定文件名放到系统目录 wqxemu/<model>/ 下，启动前选择机型。本机没有游戏内容，核心仅凭固件启动。输入使用 libretro 键盘接口，方向键同时映射到 RetroPad。

hint.en: Font ROM from a BBK A4980 device. Keep the original name 8.BIN, including its case.
hint.zh: 来自步步高 A4980 的字体 ROM，文件名必须保持为 8.BIN（区分大小写）。

hint.en: OS ROM from a BBK A4980 device. Keep the original name E.BIN, including its case.
hint.zh: 来自步步高 A4980 的系统 ROM，文件名必须保持为 E.BIN（区分大小写）。

hint.en: Font ROM for the A4988 model; only needed when bbkemu_model is set to a4988.
hint.zh: A4988 机型的字体 ROM；仅当核心选项 bbkemu_model 设为 a4988 时需要。

hint.en: OS ROM for the A4988 model; only needed when bbkemu_model is set to a4988.
hint.zh: A4988 机型的系统 ROM；仅当核心选项 bbkemu_model 设为 a4988 时需要。

notes.en: Runs .gam dictionary games on a 159x96 LCD. Requires 8.BIN and E.BIN firmware for the model selected in Core Options (a4980 by default) under BIOS/bbk/<model>/. A is Enter, B is Exit, Y is Help, X is the R key, Select is Insert and Start is Search.
notes.zh: 运行 .gam 电子词典游戏，屏幕为 159x96。需要所选机型（默认 a4980）的 8.BIN 与 E.BIN 固件，放在 BIOS/bbk/<model>/ 下。A 为确认，B 为退出，Y 为帮助，X 为 R 键，Select 为插入，Start 为查找。
